title: Conditional Rules
description: Schema for rules.json used by the conditional-rules hook system.

activation_criteria.description: Optional condition evaluated against the current project. When present and false, the entire rules.json is skipped (marketplace sources only; ignored for project-level rules). Only any_file_* predicates are allowed — triggering_file_* predicates require an active tool invocation and are rejected at config-load time.

id.description: Unique rule identifier (used as the dedup cache key).

description.description: Human-only metadata; never injected into Claude's context.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable the rule without deleting it. Defaults to true.

tools.description: Restrict to a subset of {Edit, Write, Read}. Defaults to all three.

fires_on_matcher.description: Claude-Code-style matcher against hook event names. Defaults to 'PreToolUse'.

content.description: Inline rule content. String or array-of-strings (joined with newlines).

content_file.description: Path to a file (relative to the plugin root) containing the rule content.

activation_criteria_condition.description: A condition valid inside activation_criteria. Only any_file_* predicates are permitted — triggering_file_* predicates require an active tool invocation and are a config error here.

any_file_exists.description: Project-relative path whose existence is checked (file or directory).

any_file_content_regex.description: Regex against an arbitrary file in the user's project.

path.description: Project-relative path (must stay inside the project root).

triggering_file_path_glob.description: Glob against the project-relative POSIX path of the file being touched.

triggering_file_path_regex.description: Regex (re.search) against the project-relative path of the file being touched.

triggering_file_content_regex.description: Regex (re.search) against the content of the file being touched (up to 1 MiB).

any_file_exists.description: Project-relative path whose existence is checked (file or directory).

any_file_content_regex.description: Regex against an arbitrary file in the user's project.

path.description: Project-relative path (must stay inside the project root).
